title: I've been using xDrip for about a year with the G5, I've had only one transmitter last past 90 days...Dexcom is starting to ask questions.
symptom: The user reports that their Dexcom G5 transmitter lasted only 13.5 days, whereas they expect it to last around 90 days. They are using xDrip with a Moto Z2 Play and not using the receiver, and they wonder if xDrip could be causing the short battery life.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive cause. A commenter suggests that transmitters may activate in the box before use, draining the battery, but this is speculative and not confirmed.
evidence_quote: As far as I know they just activate in the box before they are even put in to use and that drains the battery before you start.
